body: The override is removed for `/new`, but the other session teardown paths `drop_tab_session` and `reset_tab_session_for` remove their `session_to_tab` entries without removing the corresponding Yolo override or pending change. That leaks per-session state and can auto-approve a later session if an ACP server reuses the ID—the same reuse case this cleanup is intended to prevent. Apply the same `remove_session`/pending cleanup in every teardown path.

Capability discovery stops at the first matching id/category before checking its kind. A non-`Select` entry can therefore hide a later valid selector, incorrectly disabling native Yolo for an otherwise supported provider. Include the kind check in the search so discovery continues past incompatible entries.
